reason: TokenManager.initToken calls session.getProvider(TokenContextEncoderProvider.class) without a null check, but the patch always registers a provider. It adds the internal TokenContextEncoderSpi (isInternal()=true) to META-INF/services/org.keycloak.provider.Spi and registers DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory in META-INF/services/org.keycloak.protocol.oidc.encode.TokenContextEncoderProviderFactory, which is the usual Keycloak pattern for a built-in SPI with a default implementation, so the lookup does not return null in normal deployments.
